1.title: 概述
content: 作為努巴尼的守護者而生，![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎比任何人都更能守住前線。她可以說是坦克中最難被擊殺的角色，且在具備高生存能力的同時，還擁有相當不錯的傷害輸出。雖然她的機動性遠遠落後，但她的遠程傷害能力在所有坦克中名列前茅。優秀的歐瑞莎玩家會學習如何循環使用冷卻技能，並在等待 ![](/data/assets/guide/1818b49db97673b3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffortify.png)堅毅（Fortify）冷卻完畢時善用掩體。如果你想在目標點上持續進行攻擊，![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎會是一個很好的選擇。

1.1.1.title: 遊玩方式
content: * 轉向並保持距離。![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎應該始終與隊伍一同圍繞目標移動，試圖將敵方隊伍阻擋在外。

* 不要一次用盡所有技能。先使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/6c968a00b8106f0d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjavelin-spin.png)標槍旋轉，結束後再使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/1818b49db97673b3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffortify.png)強化防禦，接著使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/76027704b29fb3cb.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fenergy-javelin.png)能量標槍。將這些技能同時使用會大幅降低她的生存能力。

* 務必在掩體附近遊玩。由於 ![](/data/assets/guide/1818b49db97673b3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffortify.png)強化防禦的使用間隔總會出現空窗期，![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎需要掩體來躲避以維持生存。

1.1.2.title: 對戰策略
content: * 忽略 ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎。對付 ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎最好的方法就是避開她，並鎖定她隊伍中的其他人。她會試圖阻止你，但她無法追上你。

* 等待 ![](/data/assets/guide/1818b49db97673b3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffortify.png)堅毅（Fortify）效果結束。如果你看到她變為金色，要麼躲起來以免受到傷害，要麼切換目標去攻擊其他人。

* 使用光束型英雄。如果其他方法都無效，對付 ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎最簡單的方式就是使用光束型英雄。對於這些英雄來說，![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎簡直就是免費的絕招能量來源。

2.title: 優勢與劣勢總結
content: * 強固（Fortify）
* 適合用來進行反制選角
* 遠程傷害
* 容易受到光束武器攻擊
* 無法減免隊伍受到的傷害
* 移動緩慢且缺乏機動性

3.1.1.title: 堅毅（Fortify）
content: 進入無法阻擋的狀態並將所有受到的傷害降低近一半，是 ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎最強大的優勢。她是唯一一位能夠在向前推進並進行攻擊的同時，保持對控場效果免疫的坦克。

3.1.2.title: 絕佳的換角選擇
content: 符合劇情設定，她能透過自身的控場能力反制 ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)毀滅拳王，並利用 ![](/data/assets/guide/1818b49db97673b3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffortify.png)強化防禦的擊退免疫效果來應對。![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎也是絕佳的換角選擇，能有效封鎖 ![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)萊因哈特、![](/data/assets/guide/3f791ccf8b419b4a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Framattra.png)拉瑪塔、![](/data/assets/guide/492c99cc430727c1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Froadhog.png)攔路豬以及 ![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)災害。

3.1.3.title: 遠程傷害
content: 大多數坦克英雄的遠程傷害能力極低甚至為零。在戰鬥的消耗階段，或是處於中遠距離時，![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎能為隊伍帶來的價值將高於任何其他坦克。

3.2.1.title: 容易受到光束攻擊
content: 由於 ![](/data/assets/guide/6c968a00b8106f0d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjavelin-spin.png)標槍旋轉無法像阻擋一般傷害那樣阻擋來自 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅和 ![](/data/assets/guide/85db567c48780d42.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsymmetra.png)辛梅塔的光束傷害，因此只要 ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎無法使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/1818b49db97673b3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffortify.png)強化防禦，她就會變得非常容易受到光束攻擊的威脅。

3.2.2.title: 無團隊傷害減免
content: 與大多數其他戰士不同，![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎無法為隊伍提供任何超額生命值或護盾。她只能用自己的身體或![](/data/assets/guide/6c968a00b8106f0d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjavelin-spin.png)標槍旋轉（Javelin Spin）來吸收攻擊，但無法直接為隊友帶來任何額外的生存能力。

3.2.3.title: 機動性不足
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎最大的弱點在於開火時會被緩速、缺乏垂直機動性，且僅能從 ![](/data/assets/guide/6c968a00b8106f0d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjavelin-spin.png)標槍旋轉獲得些許移動速度加成。擁有高機動性的英雄可以輕易避開 ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎，而她對此也無能為力。

4.1.title: 主要攻擊：強化融合驅動器
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/945c6006c1ad69b0.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Faugmented-fusion-driver.png)強化融合驅動器的提示
* 保持距離並進行騷擾

* ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎的遠程傷害能力優於其他任何坦克。![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加或許能與之一較高下，但由於![](/data/assets/guide/1818b49db97673b3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffortify.png)堅毅（Fortify）的存在，他的燃燒槍枝甚至無法對![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎造成暴擊。在敵方坦克拉近距離之前，盡可能造成更多傷害。
* 不要過熱
* 在即將過熱前停止射擊，總比承受 3 秒的過熱懲罰要好。

4.2.title: 次要攻擊：能量標槍
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/76027704b29fb3cb.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fenergy-javelin.png)能量標槍的使用技巧
* 保持距離

* 由於 ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎的攻擊距離通常比其他戰士更遠，她應該利用 ![](/data/assets/guide/6c968a00b8106f0d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjavelin-spin.png)標槍旋轉來將敵人推開並保持距離。
* 保護後排

* ![](/data/assets/guide/76027704b29fb3cb.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fenergy-javelin.png)能量標槍的擊退效果是將敵人遠離你後排的強力手段。如果你發現敵方的戰士或輸出英雄正在攻擊你身後的隊友，試著用 ![](/data/assets/guide/76027704b29fb3cb.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fenergy-javelin.png)能量標槍命中他們。
* 牆壁碰撞

* 當 ![](/data/assets/guide/76027704b29fb3cb.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fenergy-javelin.png)能量標槍將敵人擊退並撞向牆壁時，會造成額外的暈眩與傷害。試著透過繞著目標移動，使他們處於你與牆壁或建築物之間，藉此發揮此優勢。

4.3.title: [SHIFT]：堅韌防禦
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/1818b49db97673b3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffortify.png)堅韌防禦的使用技巧
* ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎最重要的技能

* ![](/data/assets/guide/1818b49db97673b3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffortify.png)堅韌防禦能讓 ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎幾乎無法被擊殺，且完全無法被阻擋。當使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/1818b49db97673b3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffortify.png)堅韌防禦時，![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎可以向前推進、反制控場效果，並迫使敵方隊伍撤退。

* ![](/data/assets/guide/1818b49db97673b3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffortify.png)堅韌防禦的冷卻時間很長，因此切勿浪費。只有當你透過傷害輸出與站位對敵方造成威脅，迫使敵方隊伍必須集火你時，才啟動 ![](/data/assets/guide/1818b49db97673b3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffortify.png)堅韌防禦。
在仍有護甲時使用

* 在仍有護甲時使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/1818b49db97673b3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffortify.png)堅韌防禦，可以疊加傷害減免效果（最高可達 50%）。此外，若你在啟動技能時仍有護甲，當 ![](/data/assets/guide/1818b49db97673b3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffortify.png)堅韌防禦結束後，你更有可能還保留著部分護甲值。

如果 ![](/data/assets/guide/1818b49db97673b3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffortify.png)堅韌防禦結束且你已沒有護甲，快跑！
反制絕招

* 當敵方擁有如 ![](/data/assets/guide/7578824db04164d2.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fblizzard.png)暴雪（Blizzard）、![](/data/assets/guide/eacdf2c5d0a248f5.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fgraviton-surge.png)重力噴湧（Graviton Surge）、![](/data/assets/guide/c95892af1b952964.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fgravitic-flux.png)重力流（Gravitic Flux）、![](/data/assets/guide/eeafb396dbd4850f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdownpour.png)傾盆大雨（Downpour）等類似的暈眩型絕招時，請務必保留 ![](/data/assets/guide/1818b49db97673b3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffortify.png)堅韌防禦。

4.4.title: [E]：標槍旋轉
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/6c968a00b8106f0d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjavelin-spin.png)標槍旋轉的技巧
* 與堅毅交替使用

* 請勿在使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/1818b49db97673b3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffortify.png)堅毅的同時使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/6c968a00b8106f0d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjavelin-spin.png)標槍旋轉。你需要將這兩項生存工具分開使用，否則敵人將會有很長一段空窗期可以擊殺 ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎。
* 確保擊殺

* 由於 ![](/data/assets/guide/6c968a00b8106f0d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjavelin-spin.png)標槍旋轉可以阻擋敵人的治療與傷害投射物，同時還能對敵人造成控場效果，因此在收割低生命值目標時非常有效。

* 移動到目標與其支援角色之間，然後啟動 ![](/data/assets/guide/6c968a00b8106f0d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjavelin-spin.png)標槍旋轉，將他們推向你的隊伍。
* 旋轉無法阻擋什麼？

* 無法阻擋光束或濺射傷害，也無法在 ![](/data/assets/guide/85db567c48780d42.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsymmetra.png)辛梅塔的哨戒塔落地前將其摧毀。

4.5.title: 絕招：大地崩擊
content: **![](/data/assets/guide/135c836b3c9c24ac.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fterra-surge.png)大地崩擊的使用技巧**

* 我應該蓄力![](/data/assets/guide/135c836b3c9c24ac.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fterra-surge.png)大地崩擊多久？

* * 你需要引導![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎的絕招約 3 秒，才能一擊秒殺輸出型英雄和輔助型英雄。
* 無視屏障

* * 猛擊傷害無法被像![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)萊因哈特護盾這樣的屏障所阻擋。
* 斷開視線（LoS）可停止傷害

* * 視線（LoS）可用來避免受到傷害。因此，任何環境結構或![](/data/assets/guide/83501cfadb6150e1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmei.png)小美與![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)災害的牆體都可以阻擋傷害。
* 取得高度優勢

* * 如果![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎位於敵人上方（例如使用![](/data/assets/guide/d747d16d3747ce4f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fpetal-platform.png)花瓣平台、跳躍、從高處跳下等），敵人會先被拉到![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎所在的高度，然後必須掉落回地面才能走開。
* 務必在啟動前跳躍，但只要可能，請利用運載目標或環境來獲得額外的高度。

5.1.1.title: 防禦協議
5.1.1.description: 在引導大地崩裂（Terra Surge）期間，每秒恢復 100 點生命值。
content: * 讓 ![](/data/assets/guide/135c836b3c9c24ac.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fterra-surge.png)大地崩裂（Terra Surge）成為一個還不錯的緊急應對手段。治療效果能幫助你承受更多傷害，並在生命值偏低時救你一命。

5.1.2.title: 移動堡壘
5.1.2.description: 當「堅毅防禦（Fortify）」啟動時，歐瑞莎不會受到移動速度減益，也不會產生熱能。
content: * 非常強大，能在 ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎處於最強勢的狀態時，進一步發動侵略性的打法。讓敵方隊伍感到無可阻擋。

5.2.1.title: 蓄力標槍
5.2.1.description: 能量標槍（Energy Javelin）可以蓄力來提升投射物速度與擊退效果。在完全蓄力時可穿透敵人。
content: * 總體而言，這是較佳的主要特殊能力（Major Perk）。

* 在大多數情況下，為了護盾而放棄 ![](/data/assets/guide/6c968a00b8106f0d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjavelin-spin.png)標槍旋轉（Javelin Spin）是不划算的。![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎（Orisa）本身已經非常肉，且 ![](/data/assets/guide/6c968a00b8106f0d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjavelin-spin.png)標槍旋轉（Javelin Spin）能阻擋所有投射物長達近 2 秒。此外，期間與結束後的加速效果，加上控場能力（CC），都比擁有一個護盾來得強大。

5.2.2.title: 防護屏障
5.2.2.description: 標槍旋轉（Javelin Spin）將被替換為屏障。
content: * 視對戰組合而定

* 針對 ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加，這可能被視為較佳的主要特殊能力，因為它可以用來協助反制 ![](/data/assets/guide/b54c199ade517940.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcardiac-overdrive.png)心臟過載（Cardiac Overdrive）。

* 針對 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅，每當她使用防護泡泡時就部署屏障，以阻擋她的傷害，並減輕必須擊破她的屏障以避免她充能的壓力。

* 理論上，你可以使用屏障來阻擋 ![](/data/assets/guide/3f791ccf8b419b4a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Framattra.png)拉瑪塔絕招的視野（LoS），並嘗試提早結束該絕招。然而，600 生命值的屏障可能無法存活太久，不建議過度依賴此技巧。
* 雙重屏障小撇步
* 當處於防守方或敵隊正從重生點返回時，將屏障垂直向上發射。等到它落地時，距離你的下一個屏障冷卻時間僅剩 3 秒。

6.title: 地圖
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)在偏好消耗型隊伍的地圖上，歐瑞莎總是不錯的選擇。目標區域若擁有寬闊的空間以及筆直且漫長的護送路線，將能發揮她的長處。由於她非常耐打，在小型地圖上表現也不差，但這會讓她難以執行拉開距離的戰術。她可以利用遠程傷害來爭奪高地，但她自己無法登上高地，因此在那些有利於機動型隊伍、且擁有大量高地的地圖上，她會處於劣勢。

7.title: 隊伍陣容搭配
content: 將 ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎與其他消耗型英雄搭配，在敵方隊伍靠近你們之前就將其擊潰。她同時也是一名出色的守護者，因此當敵方隊伍採取側襲或衝鋒戰術時，她能成為對方的眼中釘，阻擋所有控場效果（CC）、將敵人擊退，並確保隊友能安全地進行攻擊。

由於她的機動性較低，像 ![](/data/assets/guide/cfaf284c1e565920.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fbaptiste.png)巴帝斯特和 ![](/data/assets/guide/2975ce75297a0957.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fillari.png)伊拉里這類支援型英雄能輕鬆地讓她的生命值保持在健康狀態。

8.title: 如何反制
content: 若要反制歐瑞莎，你需要利用她冷卻時間的空檔。如果她還有 ![](/data/assets/guide/1818b49db97673b3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffortify.png)堅毅（Fortify）和 ![](/data/assets/guide/6c968a00b8106f0d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjavelin-spin.png)標槍旋轉（Javelin Spin）可以使用，她幾乎是殺不死的。如果你看到她用掉了這兩個技能，她會有短暫的脆弱期。在堅毅（Fortify）冷卻時間結束前，迅速發動攻勢。

為了成功做到這一點，你必須確保在對方使用技能後，自己手邊仍有資源可用。因此，一旦看到她啟動 ![](/data/assets/guide/1818b49db97673b3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffortify.png)堅毅（Fortify），請專注於防守、後撤並保留冷卻技能。這樣一來，你就有足夠的手段來懲罰她並贏得會戰。
